title: FixResult
description: Final structured response for a Codex fix attempt (docs/test_environment/initial_spec.md §3's example, passed via `codex exec --output-schema`). Mapped onto test_environment/mxfix/fixer.py's FixResult dataclass by CodexFixer.run().

status.description: 'fixed': the issue is resolved and all acceptance criteria are met. 'failed': attempted but could not resolve it. 'no_change': determined no code change was needed (e.g. the issue no longer reproduces).

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of every file modified, added, or deleted.

tests_added.description: Number of new tests added, or null if not applicable/unknown.

tests_passed.description: Number of tests passing after the fix, or null if not applicable/unknown.

tests_failed.description: Number of tests still failing after the fix, or null if not applicable/unknown.

summary.description: A few sentences: what was wrong, what changed, why it's believed correct.
